description: List events captured by a bucket, newest first, with composable filters: since/until (ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD), provider, type, method, signature_valid, and q (case-insensitive search over body, content type, method, type and labels; space-separated terms must ALL match, double quotes for an exact phrase, and key:value filters by a label this bucket defines). Use cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

provider.description: Filter to a provider (e.g. stripe, github).

q.description: Case-insensitive search over body/content-type/method/type/labels. Space-separated terms must all match; use double quotes for an exact phrase, and key:value to filter by a label name and exact value.

signature_valid.description: Only events whose signature verification passed/failed.

since.description: Only events at or after this time (ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD).

type.description: The provider's own event name, matched exactly.

until.description: Only events at or before this time.

name: list_events
